_note: Hand-kept foundation seed list for the 'Grants -- organizations' sub-section, rebuilt 2026-10-26 from round-2 research (round2/funders_seed.json, 20 foundations). Most dollar ranges are secondary-aggregator sourced, not every one independently re-fetched -- see each entry's 'confidence'. src/grants.py's build_funders() applies the filter mechanically: region_tags must include 'NJ', 'MD', 'DC', or 'national' AND (unsolicited is true OR a recurring_deadlines/deadline/open-rolling cycle is given) -- entries failing that (closed programs, invitation-only, unsolicited:false with no open cycle) are in this seed file for reference but do not appear on the page. That mechanical gate is also why PSEG Foundation, William Penn Foundation, Town Creek Foundation (dissolved), Victoria Foundation, Fund for NJ, Kresge, Surdna, Geraldine R. Dodge, Healthcare Foundation of NJ, CFNJ, Cafritz Foundation, Meyer Foundation (closed for 2026), Chesapeake Bay Trust HEHC (closed program), and OSI-Baltimore (defunct/being redesigned) are all excluded below -- do NOT label the sub-section with any single organization's name regardless of which ones pass the filter.
